description: Migrate external authentication connection. Migrates an external authentication connection credentials (basic or oauth2) for a specific app and location. This endpoint validates the app configuration, stores credentials safely in CRM's native encrypted storage. With this the lifecycle of the token is managed by CRM.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_migrateConnection
